newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: GOODYEAR INVESTS IN LUXEMBOURG CENTRE.
newsitem.headline: GOODYEAR INVESTS IN LUXEMBOURG CENTRE.

text.p: U.S. tyre maker Goodyear said on Thursday it would invest 300 million francs in its Luxembourg operations, calling it the most important recruitment drive for research and development since its creation.

"Goodyear will this year hire 125 scientists and research workers; 45 of them will work at the Luxembourg technical centre," Sam Gibara, Goodyear chairman and chief executive officer, told a news conference.

"This is an investment of 300 million francs. It is the most important recruitment operation for R&D workers by Goodyear since its creation. It will cut the production cycle time, improve products and production processes," he said.
Goodyear, in Luxembourg since 1949, has a technical centre, a tyre plant and a wire plant there, employing a total 3,650 staff. Net profit was 1.8 billion francs in 1996 on turnover of 18.8 billion.
